The FD-TD method is a direct solution of Maxwell's time-dependent curl equations.
The FD-TD method uses a fully explicit numerical algorithm to simulate real-time wave propagation and scattering.

The FD-TD method is suitable for modeling structures with significant volumetric complexity.
The FD-TD method can be used to model the propagation of an electromagnetic wave into a volume of space containing a dielectric or conducting structure.

The MOM surface-patch model is suitable for low-frequency scattering problems, but can be applied to bodies spanning approximately 1 wavelength in three dimensions.
